entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I'm calling about an order, and I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I'll do my best to assist. To start, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. I bought the ProFit Jersey, and it's just the wrong size for me. It's much too tight across the shoulders. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was so excited for this.
Okay, I understand. A good fit is essential for our gear. So it's a sizing issue with the jersey. Can I get your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF90210. I was hoping to do an exchange, but I don't see another size that I think will work. Honestly, I really needed this money back... it was a big purchase for me.

I appreciate you sharing that, and I'll certainly see what I can do. Let me pull up order VF90210... I see the ProFit Jersey was delivered to you 64 days ago. One moment while I review the policy for this item.
Alright, I have good news. For that jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? You can? That's... such a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. Thank you, Isaac.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email on file. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. You've really helped me out today. Thank you so much.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
